metadata.title: MedOrbits Admissions Database
metadata.description: Structured admission records for courses, institutions, countries and academic cycles, with source evidence, review workflows and publication controls.
metadata.timezonePolicy: Use the official timezone applicable to the admission authority.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify eligibility, deadlines, application status and instructions against current authoritative sources before publication.
metadata.recordPolicy: Only current-cycle records verified against authoritative sources may be displayed as confirmed. Unverified records remain drafts or review items.

statusPolicy.verified: Display as verified only after current-cycle source evidence and material details are reviewed.
statusPolicy.pending_review: Keep in review workflow; do not present as confirmed.
statusPolicy.unverified: Store as a draft or clearly labelled unverified item; exclude from confirmed results.
statusPolicy.outdated: Do not present as current; refresh from an authoritative source.
statusPolicy.rejected: Exclude from normal display and retain only when needed for audit purposes.

dataRules: Every admission record must have a unique id.
courseId must reference an existing course record; unresolved references must be held for review.
institutionId may be null when admission is managed by a central authority rather than one institution.
countryCode must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or null only when genuinely unspecified.
academicYear must identify the applicable cycle consistently, for example 2026-2027.
Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD or null when unknown or not applicable.
applicationEnd must not precede applicationStart when both dates are supplied.
applicationStatus must reflect the latest official notice; active does not mean open.
officialUrl must point to an authoritative institution, regulator, examination authority or counselling portal.
sourceUrl must identify evidence supporting the record; a homepage alone does not substantiate a specific deadline.
verifiedAt must remain null until the record has actually been checked.
verifiedBy must identify an authorized reviewer or verification system when verification is recorded.
verificationStatus=verified requires current-cycle source evidence and review of material details.
Unverified and pending-review records must not be presented as officially confirmed.
Expired deadlines and outdated notifications must be reviewed before display.
Application links must be checked and confirmed to belong to the relevant authority before publication.
Unresolved course or institution references must be flagged for review rather than invented.
createdAt and updatedAt must be ISO 8601 timestamps with timezone or null if not recorded.
Do not store passwords, OTPs, payment credentials or unnecessary sensitive applicant data in this public dataset.
Do not infer deadlines, eligibility, status or verification from previous cycles.
note: Use current official notifications to verify eligibility, dates, application status and instructions. MedOrbits provides informational guidance and does not replace official admission authorities.
